---
title: "Stay-move hazard: remaining-time view"
format: html
---

This note estimates a "remaining-time" hazard. Instead of weighting each stay
equally, each *day within a stay* contributes one observation. This gives the
probability of moving as a function of **days remaining until the move**, as
seen from a randomly chosen day within stays.

Forward-time hazard (used in `scripts/plot_stay_move.R`):

$$
h_f(k) = \Pr(k \le T < k+1 \mid T \ge k)
$$

Remaining-time hazard:

Let `R = T - K`, where `T` is the stay duration in days and `K` is the integer
day index within the stay (`K = 0, 1, ..., floor(T)`). Then

$$
h_r(r) = \Pr(r \le R < r+1 \mid R \ge r)
$$

Because each stay contributes one `R` per day, longer stays are naturally
weighted more, which makes this curve differ from the forward hazard when the
process is not memoryless.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GeoPressureR)
library(readr)

find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    has_r_dir <- dir.exists(file.path(current, "R"))
    has_readme <- file.exists(file.path(current, "README.md"))
    if (has_r_dir && has_readme) {
      return(current)
    }
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (parent == current) {
      stop("Could not find repo root containing R/ and README.md.")
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

repo_root <- find_repo_root()
staps <- read_csv(
  file.path(repo_root, "data", "master", "staps.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
staps$duration_days <- stap2duration(staps, units = "days")

max_day <- 50

# Discrete-time hazard of moving in the next day given the stay is ongoing.
hazard_by_day <- function(dur, max_day = floor(max(dur, na.rm = TRUE))) {
  t <- 0:max_day
  n_risk <- sapply(t, \(k) sum(dur >= k, na.rm = TRUE))
  n_event <- sapply(t, \(k) sum(dur >= k & dur < (k + 1), na.rm = TRUE))
  data.frame(
    day = t,
    n_risk = n_risk,
    n_event = n_event,
    hazard = ifelse(n_risk > 0, n_event / n_risk, NA_real_)
  )
}

clamp_prob <- function(x, eps = 1e-4) {
  pmin(pmax(x, eps), 1 - eps)
}

# Exponential decay to an asymptote: hazard = p_inf + (p0 - p_inf) * exp(-rate * day).
fit_exp_hazard <- function(haz_df) {
  fit_data <- haz_df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(hazard), n_risk > 0)
  if (nrow(fit_data) < 4) {
    return(list(p_inf = NA_real_, p0 = NA_real_, rate = NA_real_))
  }

  start_p0 <- min(1, max(fit_data$hazard, na.rm = TRUE))
  start_p_inf <- max(0, min(fit_data$hazard, na.rm = TRUE))
  start_span <- (start_p0 - start_p_inf) / max(1e-6, 1 - start_p_inf)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    stats::nls(
      hazard ~ plogis(a) + (1 - plogis(a)) * plogis(b) * exp(-rate * day),
      data = fit_data,
      weights = n_risk,
      start = list(
        a = stats::qlogis(clamp_prob(start_p_inf)),
        b = stats::qlogis(clamp_prob(start_span)),
        rate = 0.05
      ),
      algorithm = "port",
      lower = c(a = -Inf, b = -Inf, rate = 0),
      upper = c(a = Inf, b = Inf, rate = Inf)
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(list(p_inf = NA_real_, p0 = NA_real_, rate = NA_real_))
  }
  coef_vals <- stats::coef(fit)
  p_inf <- stats::plogis(coef_vals["a"])
  p_span <- stats::plogis(coef_vals["b"])
  p0 <- p_inf + (1 - p_inf) * p_span
  list(
    p_inf = unname(p_inf),
    p0 = unname(p0),
    rate = unname(coef_vals["rate"])
  )
}

# Build remaining-time observations: one per day per stay.
dur <- staps$duration_days
remaining_times <- unlist(
  lapply(dur, function(d) {
    if (is.na(d) || d <= 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    k <- 0:floor(d)
    d - k
  }),
  use.names = FALSE
)

haz_remaining <- hazard_by_day(remaining_times, max_day = max_day)
exp_fit_remaining <- fit_exp_hazard(haz_remaining)
exp_curve_remaining <- data.frame(
  day = 0:max_day,
  hazard = exp_fit_remaining$p_inf +
    (exp_fit_remaining$p0 - exp_fit_remaining$p_inf) *
      exp(-exp_fit_remaining$rate * (0:max_day))
)
exp_label_remaining <- data.frame(
  day = max_day,
  hazard = exp_fit_remaining$p_inf +
    (exp_fit_remaining$p0 - exp_fit_remaining$p_inf) *
      exp(-exp_fit_remaining$rate * max_day),
  label = ifelse(
    is.finite(exp_fit_remaining$p0) &
      is.finite(exp_fit_remaining$p_inf) &
      is.finite(exp_fit_remaining$rate),
    sprintf(
      "p0=%.3f, p_inf=%.3f, rate=%.3f",
      exp_fit_remaining$p0,
      exp_fit_remaining$p_inf,
      exp_fit_remaining$rate
    ),
    "fit failed"
  )
)

ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = haz_remaining,
    ggplot2::aes(day, hazard),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = exp_curve_remaining,
    ggplot2::aes(day, hazard),
    color = "gray30"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = exp_label_remaining,
    ggplot2::aes(day, hazard, label = label),
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = -0.4,
    color = "gray30"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Days remaining until move",
    y = "P(move next day | still here)"
  )
```
